coordinate_contract.world: Original COLMAP world coordinates and arbitrary reconstruction units.
coordinate_contract.camera: World-to-camera R,t; camera x right, y down, z forward; calibrated fx,fy,cx,cy and image dimensions.
coordinate_contract.gaussians: Graphdeco PLY: xyz, log scales, wxyz quaternion, opacity logit, SH coefficients in channel-major order.
coordinate_contract.mask: PNG grayscale 0 background / 255 editable foreground; tensors use 0/1.
coordinate_contract.depth: Volumetric sum of alpha-composited Euclidean camera distances. Control image is 1 - minmax(depth) over valid alpha, repeated over RGB channels.
coordinate_contract.new_object_local: x right, y floor-up, z toward the anchor; world xyz = local xyz @ axes.T * scale + center. Checkpoint records the exact similarity transform.

modules.name: 3D localization
modules.invariant: Index arrays partition the original PLY rows; retained background tensors are unchanged.

modules.name: Generation-region adapter
modules.invariant: The upright generated-object region is separate from old-object deletion indices.

modules.name: AVP
modules.invariant: All selected-image modalities share the stored 512x512 calibrated anchor camera.

modules.name: Depth-conditioned inpainting
modules.invariant: Save every fixed-seed candidate and automatic ranking. Selected image retains anchor pixel coordinates.

modules.name: SAM extraction
modules.invariant: SAM predicts the mask from automatically derived prompts; no hand-traced mask or supplied replacement asset.

modules.name: Coarse 3D-SDS
modules.invariant: Stable Zero123 remains frozen; 6500 optimizer updates change only new-object Gaussians.

modules.name: Scene composition
modules.invariant: Assert bitwise identity of retained source PLY rows before accepting composition.

modules.name: DI-SDS refinement
modules.invariant: 2000 updates with 4 sampled views, frozen inpainting/ControlNet models and retained background; RGB/mask plus DI-SDS, with Zero123 disabled.
